_note: A short, hand-picked core vocabulary for each genre: its mood (adjectives, a) and its characteristic actions (verbs, v), single words as WordNet has them. They are the strongest seeds of the genre fit (genrefit.py), so the first words the Genre words tab offers for a genre are these and their neighbors, not whatever the subject domains of the dictionary happen to hold. Words the dictionary lacks are ignored.
